# SysInfo Pro

> SysInfo Pro is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows 10 and 11 app that explains in plain words why a PC is slow, what is filling its drive and what is wrong with a developer setup, and helps fix it. Every tool works without administrator rights. It is published by Probably Fine Labs on the Microsoft Store.

Key facts:

- Name: SysInfo Pro (sometimes written SysInfoPro or "Sys Info Pro")
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit
- Price: free; no account, no ads, no telemetry
- Get it: Microsoft Store (product ID 9PD2G09HCXK3), or the program file from GitHub releases; also `winget install 9PD2G09HCXK3`
- License: MIT; source on GitHub
- Current version: 3.2
- Built with Go, Wails and Svelte; runs as a standard user, read-only until the user confirms a change
- Not a "PC cleaner" or "booster": it reports what Windows and the drives actually measure, with no scare tactics

## Get it

- [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9pd2g09hcxk3): recommended; installs and updates automatically
- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/anandhuremanan/sysinfopro/releases/latest): single program file, no installer
